FAIL_TO_PASS: loads a CommonJS config file exporting a config as a function with defineConfig()
format-aliases: supports format aliases
config-ts-with-workspace-refs: supports loading TypeScript config files referencing workspace projects
custom-frame: errors with plugin generated code frames also contain stack
custom-frame-with-pos: custom (plugin generated) code frame taking priority over pos generated one
warn-unknown-options: warns about unknown CLI options
no-treeshake: generates IIFE export with all code and overrides config
config-promise-cjs: uses cjs config file which returns a Promise
config-function: if the config file returns a function then this will be called with the command args
config-async-function: supports using an async function as config
warn-this: warns "this" is used on the top level
silent: does not print logs with --silent
config-override: overrides config file with command line arguments
config-file: does not replace input with stdin but allows referencing it when using a config file
silent-onwarn: triggers onwarn with --silent
watch-config-early-update: immediately reloads the config file if a change happens while it is parsed
force-exit: force exits even with open handles
config: uses config file
logs: displays logs
clearScreen: clears the screen before bundling
